title: an exponent literal beyond binary64 is rejected
purpose: Invalid source is rejected before execution.

rejection.justification: 1e400 is a well-formed float literal whose value is not a finite binary64; the checker rejects it, as it rejects a literal that is not zero but rounds to 0.0.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS with issue #45; exponents became float literals in #57
provenance.expected_basis: FLOAT allows an exponent; a literal must denote a finite binary64 value (spec 4.2).
